seoTitle: Create a Marketing Email Using Your GoDaddy Domain
metaDescription: Send branded marketing emails using your GoDaddy domain. Learn how to set up a custom address, build campaigns, and track opens and clicks.
intro: Sending marketing emails from a branded address like sales@yourdomain.com looks more professional and builds trust with recipients compared to a generic email service. This guide covers setting up a custom email address on GoDaddy and using its Email Marketing or Microsoft 365 tools to build and track campaigns.

steps.heading: Create a custom email address
steps.body: Set up a branded address such as sales@yourdomain.com using your GoDaddy domain and email service.

steps.heading: Choose your email marketing tool
steps.body: Decide between GoDaddy's Email Marketing product or Microsoft 365 tools depending on which fits your campaign needs.

steps.heading: Craft a responsive email campaign
steps.body: Build your email content using GoDaddy's templates, making sure it displays well across desktop and mobile inboxes.

steps.heading: Send the campaign to your list
steps.body: Send your finished campaign out to your contact list once the content and design are ready.

steps.heading: Track open and click rates
steps.body: Review your campaign's performance data, including open and click rates, to see how recipients engaged with the email.

faq.question: Do I need Microsoft 365 to send marketing emails from GoDaddy?
faq.answer: Not necessarily — GoDaddy's own Email Marketing tool is an option, though Microsoft 365 is also covered as an alternative route.

faq.question: Can I use pre-built templates for my campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes, GoDaddy provides email templates that can be customized rather than requiring you to design a campaign from scratch.

faq.question: How do I know if my marketing email is performing well?
faq.answer: Open and click rate tracking gives you a direct way to measure how recipients are engaging with your campaign.

faq.question: Is a branded email address required for marketing campaigns?
faq.answer: It's not strictly required, but sending from a custom domain email generally builds more trust than a generic address.
